summary.text: Ryan Nawrocki is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 7A and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He and fellow incumbent Kathy Szeliga face Democrats Lydia Xinzhen Brown and Satish Chapagain for the district's two seats.
He has worked in communications for state and federal government and owns a business, and he serves on the Environment and Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Nawrocki graduated from Loyola Blakefield High School in 2001, earned a B.A. from St. Mary's College of Maryland in 2006, and received a master's degree in public administration from Johns Hopkins University in 2017.

His legislative biography lists him as a public information officer at the Maryland Aviation Administration, communications coordinator at LifeBridge Health, and communications director in the U.S. House of Representatives from 2011 to 2016.

He was senior director of communications and marketing at the Maryland Transit Administration from 2016 to 2017, a partner at Latitude Red from 2019 to 2023, and has owned Green Relief Health since 2020.
Nawrocki assumed office on January 11, 2023, according to Ballotpedia.
The General Assembly website lists him as a member of the Environment and Transportation Committee.
